name: VolcanoBot 2
def: Small two wheeled tethered robot built to crawl into volcanic fissures at Kilauea and map their inner shape in three dimensions.
body: The VolcanoBots are hand sized robots with two large wheels and a tether, designed to be lowered into cracks far too narrow and hot for a person. VolcanoBot 1 descended 25 metres into a fissure near the Pu'u O'o crater on Kilauea in 2014, and the smaller, lighter VolcanoBot 2 returned in 2015 with better cameras and a more capable depth sensor. The three dimensional models they produced help volcanologists understand how magma moves through the plumbing of a volcano.
facts: Descended 25 metres into a Kilauea fissure in 2014
Produced three dimensional maps of fissure interiors
specs: Two wheels with a tether for power, data and recovery
Camera and depth sensor for three dimensional mapping
